## Fixes

- Fix recent eMudhra CA cert compromise and remove them from the bundled JDK trust store
- Fix settings changed on another system being reverted by the git vault sync
- Fix local plain directory sync deleting files in the sync directory that don't belong to XPipe
- Fix SSH connections with SessionType none in their options failing to start
- Fix child connections possibly losing their parent connection after a vault sync
- Fix AOT error caused by an aggressive EDR causing errors during terminal launches
- Fix rare errors on Linux when dragging files over file browser tabs

## Changes

- The freeze connection configurations category setting has been reworked into confirm all configuration changes, which asks for confirmation before connections in that category are edited, renamed, moved, or deleted instead of making them read-only
- The confirm all modifications category setting has been renamed to confirm all system modifications to make clear that it applies to operations on the systems
- The disable all modifications category setting has been renamed to disable scripts to reflect what it actually disables
- Network devices like Cisco and Juniper switches can now be used as basic SSH connections without a license, only the switch-specific features require one
